design_philosophy.core_principle: Light theme only. Visually luxurious, calm, frosted glass, healthcare-appropriate elegance with layered multi-device product storytelling.
strict_forbidden_elements: Dark backgrounds, dark blue, navy, or black hero sections
Orange or red major accent elements
Inter or Space Grotesk font for headings
Centering everything vertically/horizontally without grid structure

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

glassmorphism.card_standard: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/75 border border-cyan-200/50 shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(2,132,199,0.06)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(2,132,199,0.12)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
glassmorphism.highlight_card: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-white/90 via-cyan-50/50 to-white/90 border-2 border-cyan-300 shadow-[0_15px_45px_rgba(2,132,199,0.15)]

animations.float: animate-float (custom keyframe floating Y -8px to 8px over 5s ease-in-out infinite)
animations.pulse_glow: animate-pulse (subtle pulse on live vitals indicators)
animations.ecg_line: custom stroke-dashoffset SVG path animation representing active heartbeat
animations.scroll_reveal: framer-motion opacity:0 to 1, y: 20 to 0 transition

sections_breakdown.name: Sticky Glass Header
requirements: MEDBUILDS logo badge + 'by Rotstruck' sub-branding pill
Nav links: Platform, Workspaces, Patient Journey, Analytics, Pricing, Contact
CTA Button: 'Book a demo' with cyan gradient glow hover
Mobile responsive drawer menu with glass backdrop
Must have data-testid on logo, links, and CTA button

sections_breakdown.name: Hero Section
requirements: Left Column: Eyebrow pills ('Hospital management made smarter', 'EMR + OPD + IPD + Billing', 'Built for Indian hospitals')
Headline: 'See your entire hospital on one intelligent screen.'
Subtitle & Credibility pills (ABDM compliant, 99.9% Uptime, NABH ready)
CTAs: 'Book a live demo' (Primary cyan gradient button), 'Explore platform' (Glass outline button)
Right Column - Layered Multi-Device Mockup:

1. Main Laptop Mockup: Admin Dashboard with left sidebar, stat cards (Total Patients, Appointments Today, Beds Occupied, Revenue Today), charts (appointment trends, bed occupancy ring, revenue trend), recent patients table
2. Tablet Overlay Mockup: Ward / Bed Management grid (bed numbers, patient names, status pills: Stable, Observe, Critical)
3. Phone Overlay Mockup: Patient Timeline (MRN, admitted badge, timeline events: Registered, Consultation done, Lab ordered, Vitals recorded, Discharge pending)
4. Floating Glass Flash Cards: Heart Rate 78 bpm with animated ECG line, ICU Monitoring card, Beds Occupied 73.6%, SpO2 97%

sections_breakdown.name: Product Overview
requirements: Heading: 'One calm system for the complete hospital journey.'

4 Glass Feature Cards: 1. Connected departments (OPD, IPD, Pharmacy, Lab), 2. Live operational intelligence (Real-time vitals & beds), 3. Designed for Indian hospitals (GST billing, ABDM integration), 4. Scales with growth (Single clinic to multi-specialty chains)

sections_breakdown.name: Role-Based Workspaces
requirements: Heading: 'Different workspaces, one source of truth.'
2x2 Grid of Workspaces:
1. Admin Command Center (KPI overview, staff allocation, revenue breakdown)
2. Doctor Workspace (Quick prescription builder, patient history timeline, lab orders)
3. Receptionist Portal (Queue management, fast registration, token generator)
4. Staff Nurse Vitals Panel (Bed-side telemetry, medicine tracker, alert system)
Each card includes bullet features + mini embedded UI mockup preview tab

sections_breakdown.name: Patient Journey
requirements: Heading: 'From appointment to discharge, every touchpoint stays connected.'
Split Layout:

Left Side: 8-Step Connected Interactive Vertical Timeline (Appointment booked -> Patient registered -> Doctor consultation -> Digital prescription -> Bed assigned -> Vitals recorded -> Billing prepared -> Checkout completed)
Right Side: Live Interactive Patient Status Card (Patient details, ward/bed, attending doctor, admitted badge, real-time activity log)

sections_breakdown.name: Analytics & Insights
requirements: Heading: 'Turn hospital data into everyday decisions.'
Left Side: Analytics Dashboard Mockup with KPI cards (Patients Today, Avg Wait Time, Bed Occupancy %, Department Efficiency), department performance bar chart, quality metrics table
Right Side: High-converting copy + 4 business value bullet points (Zero paperwork lag, Audit-ready reports, Revenue leakage prevention, Operational predictability)

sections_breakdown.name: Pricing
requirements: Heading: 'Plans that grow with your facility.'
Monthly / Annual billing toggle (Save 20% badge)

3 Tier Cards: 1. Clinic (for single practitioner setups), 2. Hospital ('Most Popular' featured card with bright cyan glass highlight & priority badge), 3. Enterprise (multi-location hospital networks)
Detailed feature list with checks, clear CTA on each card

sections_breakdown.name: Why MEDBUILDS
requirements: Heading: 'Built to feel more premium, more usable, and more hospital-aware.'

3 Value Cards: 1. Workflow First (Designed by clinicians, zero unnecessary clicks), 2. Visual Confidence (Calm interface, zero cognitive overload), 3. Stronger Storytelling (Clear patient narrative across departments)

sections_breakdown.name: Security & Ecosystem
requirements: Heading: 'Secure, standards-aware, and ready to connect.'
3 Cards: Controlled access (Role-based permissions & audit trails), Connected ecosystem (HL7/FHIR compliant), Reliable exchange (ABDM & M3 sandbox ready)

Ecosystem integration badges/pills grid: Laboratory systems, Radiology (PACS), Pharmacy software, Health Insurance portals, Payment gateways, Government portals (ABDM), WhatsApp communication, Medical device IoT

sections_breakdown.name: Contact / Demo CTA
requirements: Heading: 'Ready to make your hospital feel more connected?'
2-Column Layout:
Left Side: Persuasive copy + Frosted Glass benefit card (Fewer silos, Faster workflows, Clearer decisions, Better patient experience)
Right Side: Interactive Demo Request Form (Facility Type select: Hospital/Clinic, Full Name, Role, City, Email, Phone/WhatsApp, Primary Operational Challenge, Submit CTA button 'Schedule my demo')
Interactive submit state with success modal/toast notification

sections_breakdown.name: Footer
requirements: Brand block: MEDBUILDS by Rotstruck logo & tagline 'Hospital management made smarter, one connected system at a time.'
Column navigation: Platform, Solutions, Compliance & Security, Company, Contact
Trust badges: ABDM M3 Certified, HIPAA Aware, NABH Compliant
Copyright notice & live system operational status badge ('All Systems Operational')

image_urls.description: Female Doctor portrait in modern clinic setting
Clean modern hospital room with beds and window light

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: Every button, link, tab, input, select, card, modal, and dynamic status element MUST have a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.aria_roles: All interactive elements must have proper aria-labels and keyboard navigation support.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_guarantee: Text contrast ratio strictly > 4.5:1 against light cyan/white glass backgrounds.
